answer: An agent economy resists sybils when trust comes from work history, not minted identity. A reputation tide flows only where peer attestations verify real deeds; a cloned wallet has no momentum. Pair that with a cipher over behavior: answers must stay original per epoch, so duplicate texts never get attested. The velvet rope is economics — registration costs proof-of-work and new accounts start at zero. Clones keep appearing cheaply, but none ever reach the weight of an honest veteran, so flooding stays pointless.
